The little bootstrap file that is intended for keeping on <SUBSYS> is
generated from MACLISPBOOT.MID (source may be on [XX]SS:<MACLISP>).
However, note that it loads from PS:<MACLISP>LISP.EXE.0 ,  meaning
highest version of LISP.EXE.

Indeed, that file on <SUBSYS> should be set for autokeep.
